description.fr_FR: Pilotez vos enceintes Devialet (Phantom, Expert, Dialog, etc.) via l'API locale IP Control. Contrôle du volume, lecture, sources, sourdine et mode nuit.
description.en_US: Control your Devialet speakers (Phantom, Expert, Dialog, etc.) through the local IP Control API. Volume, playback, sources, mute and night mode control.
